recommendation: KEEP the verified flank: no beta step. The pre-registered rule (prereg.json, commit 0761f77) found no grid beta with >= 2 deg to both caps (every step trades the crank margin for horn margin under 2 deg; gap ties). The as-built analysis shows the crank-side cliff is a synthesis artefact: the built flank keeps its stroke and PA cap at every machining error tested (cap at r_c -0.4..-0.5 mm).
